notes: The livestock here come from the Exeter Domesday additions.
Named as a member of Wiltshire 1,1; its people may be counted with that manor, and part of that manor's households is drawn here (an estimate).

q: Wiltshire 6,1

The Bishop of Lisieux holds YATTON [Keynell]. Leofnoth held it before 1066; it paid tax for 2 hides and 3 virgates. Land for 3 ploughs, of which 2 hides in lordship; 1 plough there; 2 smallholders and 6 Cottagers with 1 plough.
notes: The livestock here come from the Exeter Domesday additions.

q: Wiltshire 64,1

Jocelyn [of] Rivers holds ZEALS from the King. Almer held it before 1066; it paid tax for 2 1/2 hides. Land for 3 ploughs. In lordship 1 plough; 2 slaves; 5 villagers and 3 Cottagers with 2 ploughs. A mill which pays 40d;
notes: The livestock here come from the Exeter Domesday additions.
